name: ai.tenprint/tenprint
title: TenPrint
description: Post-quantum AI compliance attestation. Free local tier; API key anchors to Hedera.

environmentVariables.name: TENPRINT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the stdio transport. Optional; omit for the free local tier. RUBRIC_API_KEY is a deprecated stdio fallback. HTTP tools/call ignores this and requires Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key on the request.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key for x402 paid tools on stdio (USDC on Base). Omit to receive setup guidance instead of a charge. Ignored in HTTP mode, where x402 tools are disabled.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_MCP_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool modules to expose. Default is core,x402. Use all for every module.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key required on the request for tools/call. The server environment key is not a substitute. initialize and tools/list work without it.
